description.sl: Osem profilov: osnovni testi, RHP, ponovitve in Mistral zanke. Različni protokoli ostanejo ločeni.
description.en: Eight profiles: baseline, RHP, retries and Mistral loops. Different protocols remain separate.

description.sl: 171 sprejetih javnih zapisov. Strogi testi, zasnove in hibridni koraki niso ena skupna ocena.
description.en: 171 accepted public records. Strict tests, designs and hybrid steps are not a combined score.

description.sl: Poziv OK: 12/13 PASS. Ministral je izčrpal kontekst 4096 brez odgovora; ni dosegel enourne meje. Čas je native HTTP.
description.en: OK prompt: 12/13 PASS. Ministral exhausted context 4096 without an answer, not the one-hour limit. Time is native HTTP.

description.sl: GPT-OSS: en predlog, vsebina in diff FAIL. Terra: mehanski pregled uspešen, semantični pregled čaka.
description.en: GPT-OSS: one proposal, content and diff FAIL. Terra: mechanical checks passed; semantic review pending.

description.sl: Qwen3.5-9B 6/10 PASS, Gemma4-12B 9/10 PASS. Kontekst 32768, native thinking. Proračun se razlikuje od starejših testov.
description.en: Qwen3.5-9B 6/10 PASS, Gemma4-12B 9/10 PASS. Context 32768, native thinking. Budgets differ from older tests.

description.sl: Izvedene celice RHP. Delni posnetek ni dokaz zaključene celotne baterije.
description.en: Executed RHP cells. A partial snapshot does not prove completion of the full battery.

description.sl: Naročninski CLI, xhigh: osnovni testi, RHP in HMAL OK. HELM in L1 sta v namenskih razdelkih. Čas vključuje CLI režijo.
description.en: Subscription CLI, xhigh: baseline, RHP and HMAL OK. HELM and L1 have their own sections. Time includes CLI overhead.

description.sl: Lokalni HOME32 je bil 27. 10. pripravljen in zadržan, brez inference. Izvedene Terra celice so ločene; izbor krmarja čaka HELM-R1.1.
description.en: Local HOME32 was prepared and held on 27 Oct without inference. Executed Terra cells stay separate; selection awaits HELM-R1.1.

description.sl: max_tokens kot na Windows (T001 2048, ostali 1024), do 1200 s na odgovor. Gemma4 12B 7/10 PASS. Qwen3.5 9B: 2 PASS v šestih primerih; T007–T010 niso tekli, ker je BD ob 00:15 po lokalnem času naročil odpravo meja. Vseh 6 INCOMPLETE je brez končnega odgovora: max_tokens je zmanjkalo med razmišljanjem.
description.en: max_tokens as on Windows (T001 2048, others 1024), up to 1200 s per answer. Gemma4 12B 7/10 PASS. Qwen3.5 9B: 2 PASS in six cases; T007–T010 were not run because BD ordered the limits lifted at 00:15 local time. All 6 INCOMPLETE have no final answer: max_tokens ran out while thinking.

description.sl: Isti T001–T010 brez max_tokens (celo okno 4096), temperatura 0 kot na Windows, do 3600 s na odgovor. Pravilni odgovori: GPT-OSS 20B 9/10, Gemma4 12B 9/10, Qwen3.5 9B 7/10, LFM2.5 7/10, Mellum2.1 7/10, Magistral 7/10, Ministral3 5/10. Strogo, brez Markdown ograje: Magistral 5/10, Ministral3 0/10. Veliki modeli so v ločenem razdelku.
description.en: Same T001–T010 without max_tokens (whole 4096 window), temperature 0 as on Windows, up to 3600 s per answer. Correct answers: GPT-OSS 20B 9/10, Gemma4 12B 9/10, Qwen3.5 9B 7/10, LFM2.5 7/10, Mellum2.1 7/10, Magistral 7/10, Ministral3 5/10. Strict, without a Markdown fence: Magistral 5/10, Ministral3 0/10. Large models have their own section.

description.sl: Vseh deset primerov s priporočenimi nastavitvami proizvajalcev, ne s temperaturo 0 (Gemma brez razmišljanja, Qwen3.8 z nizkim razmišljanjem). Pravilni odgovori: Qwen3.8 27B 9/10, Gemma4 31B Q5 7/10. Strogo, brez Markdown ograje: 7/10 in 1/10. Gemma4 31B Q6 je tekel 9. 11. zvečer, ko je bil RAM prost, brez razmišljanja (na Windows z njim): pravilni odgovori 7/10, strogo 2/10, 0,86 žetona/s.
description.en: All ten cases with the vendors' recommended settings, not temperature 0 (Gemma without thinking, Qwen3.8 with low thinking). Correct answers: Qwen3.8 27B 9/10, Gemma4 31B Q5 7/10. Strict, without a Markdown fence: 7/10 and 1/10. Gemma4 31B Q6 ran on the evening of 9 Nov, once RAM was free, without thinking (on Windows with it): 7/10 correct answers, 2/10 strict, 0.86 tokens/s.

description.sl: Ponovitve primerov brez PASS, po en poskus. RETEST PROFILE: celo okno s priporočenimi nastavitvami (Ministral in Magistral tudi način JSON). RETEST JSON: veliki modeli z istimi nastavitvami in načinom JSON. PASS je dobilo 15 od 38 ponovitev. Najboljše, če šteje pravilen odgovor (tudi v Markdown ograji) v osnovnem teku ali ponovitvi: Qwen3.8 27B 10/10, GPT-OSS 20B 9/10, Gemma4 12B 9/10, Qwen3.5 9B 8/10, LFM2.5 8/10, Mellum2.1 7/10, Magistral 7/10, Gemma4 31B Q5 7/10, Ministral3 5/10; Gemma4 31B Q6 v tem krogu ni tekel (osnovni tek 9. 11. zvečer: 7/10).
description.en: Re-tests of non-PASS cases, one attempt each. RETEST PROFILE: whole window with recommended settings (Ministral and Magistral also JSON mode). RETEST JSON: large models with the same settings plus JSON mode. 15 of 38 re-tests passed. Best when a correct answer (also inside a Markdown fence) in the base run or a re-test counts: Qwen3.8 27B 10/10, GPT-OSS 20B 9/10, Gemma4 12B 9/10, Qwen3.5 9B 8/10, LFM2.5 8/10, Mellum2.1 7/10, Magistral 7/10, Gemma4 31B Q5 7/10, Ministral3 5/10; Gemma4 31B Q6 did not run in this round (base run on the evening of 9 Nov: 7/10).

description.sl: Razmišljanje vklopljeno, do ene ure na odgovor. Z nastavitvami kot na Windows (okno 4096): Gemma 4 31B Q6 10/10 (strogo 1), 0,79 žetona/s, 9,3 min na nalogo; Gemma 4 31B Q5 10/10 (strogo 1), 0,89 žetona/s, 9,1 min na nalogo; Ministral 3 14B 5/10 (strogo 0), 1,74 žetona/s, 25,7 s na nalogo; Qwen3.8 27B (razmišljanje xhigh) še teče. Novi modeli z nastavitvami proizvajalcev in večjim oknom: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B (okno 8192) 10/10 (strogo 10), 7,05 žetona/s, 3,1 min na nalogo; Gemma 4 26B-A4B (okno 16384) 6/10 (strogo 5), 7,70 žetona/s, 2,6 min na nalogo; EXAONE 4.5 33B je na vrsti.
description.en: Thinking on, up to one hour per answer. With the Windows settings (window 4096): Gemma 4 31B Q6 10/10 (strict 1), 0.79 tokens/s, 9.3 min per case; Gemma 4 31B Q5 10/10 (strict 1), 0.89 tokens/s, 9.1 min per case; Ministral 3 14B 5/10 (strict 0), 1.74 tokens/s, 25.7 s per case; Qwen3.8 27B (reasoning xhigh) is still running. New models with the vendors' settings and a larger window: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B (window 8192) 10/10 (strict 10), 7.05 tokens/s, 3.1 min per case; Gemma 4 26B-A4B (window 16384) 6/10 (strict 5), 7.70 tokens/s, 2.6 min per case; EXAONE 4.5 33B is queued.

description.sl: Vsaka naloga je en nov klic codex exec (codex-cli 0.167.0) prek naročnine, brez ukazne vrstice in drugih orodij, spleta ter uporabniških nastavitev; en poskus. Pravilni odgovori: Terra low 10/10, Terra medium 10/10, Terra high 10/10, Terra xhigh 10/10, Sol low 10/10, Astra medium 10/10, Luna low 8/10. Luna je T003 in T005 rešila vsebinsko napačno. Mediana 5,0 s na nalogo; čas vključuje režijo CLI.
description.en: Each case is one fresh codex exec call (codex-cli 0.167.0) on the subscription, with the shell and other tools, web and user settings off; one attempt. Correct answers: Terra low 10/10, Terra medium 10/10, Terra high 10/10, Terra xhigh 10/10, Sol low 10/10, Astra medium 10/10, Luna low 8/10. Luna got T003 and T005 wrong in content. Median 5.0 s per case; time includes CLI overhead.

description.sl: Vsaka naloga je en nov klic claude -p (2.1.319) prek naročnine, brez orodij, spleta in uporabniških nastavitev (--safe-mode); en poskus. Pravilni odgovori (PASS; Markdown ograja okoli pravilnega odgovora ni napaka): Haiku low 10/10, Sonnet low 9/10, Sonnet medium 9/10, Sonnet high 9/10, Sonnet max 9/10, Opus high 10/10, Opus max 10/10, Fable high 10/10. Strogo, brez ograje: Haiku low 9, Sonnet low 8, Sonnet medium 8, Sonnet high 8, Sonnet max 8, Opus high 5, Opus max 3, Fable high 9. Sonnet pri T005 zapiše robove kot pare točk. Mediana 4,2 s na nalogo; čas vključuje režijo CLI.
description.en: Each case is one fresh claude -p call (2.1.319) on the subscription, with no tools, web or user settings (--safe-mode); one attempt. Correct answers (PASS; a Markdown fence around a correct answer is not an error): Haiku low 10/10, Sonnet low 9/10, Sonnet medium 9/10, Sonnet high 9/10, Sonnet max 9/10, Opus high 10/10, Opus max 10/10, Fable high 10/10. Strict, without fences: Haiku low 9, Sonnet low 8, Sonnet medium 8, Sonnet high 8, Sonnet max 8, Opus high 5, Opus max 3, Fable high 9. Sonnet writes the T005 edges as point pairs. Median 4.2 s per case; time includes CLI overhead.

description.sl: Padli primeri JSON še enkrat, s strukturiranim izhodom CLI (shema s samo obliko, ki jo navaja naloga); T009 (koda) ni ponovljen. PASS je dobilo 10 od 16 ponovitev. Ker ograja ne šteje več kot napaka, so Opusove ponovitve le potrditev. Najboljše, če šteje pravilen odgovor v osnovnem teku ali ponovitvi: Terra low 10/10, Terra medium 10/10, Terra high 10/10, Terra xhigh 10/10, Sol low 10/10, Astra medium 10/10, Luna low 8/10, Haiku low 10/10, Sonnet low 9/10, Sonnet medium 9/10, Sonnet high 9/10, Sonnet max 9/10, Opus high 10/10, Opus max 10/10, Fable high 10/10.
description.en: Failed JSON cases once more with the CLI's structured output (a schema with only the shape the case states); T009 (code) not re-run. 10 of 16 re-tests passed. Since a fence no longer counts as an error, the Opus re-runs only confirm it. Best when a correct answer in the base run or a re-test counts: Terra low 10/10, Terra medium 10/10, Terra high 10/10, Terra xhigh 10/10, Sol low 10/10, Astra medium 10/10, Luna low 8/10, Haiku low 10/10, Sonnet low 9/10, Sonnet medium 9/10, Sonnet high 9/10, Sonnet max 9/10, Opus high 10/10, Opus max 10/10, Fable high 10/10.

description.sl: Isti GPT-OSS 20B MXFP4 (llama.cpp b12141, Vulkan, kontekst 4096) prek različnih odjemalcev, en kratek krog. Pet nalog (T001, T002, T007, T008, T009), samo uporabniško sporočilo in privzeto vzorčenje (temperatura 0,8): llama-cli 3/5, HTML klepet 4/5, neposredni HTTP 4/5 in 4/5. Codex Local je agentno nalogo (popravek stats.py z neodvisnim preverjanjem) rešil 2/2. OpenCode Local ni tekel, ker zahteva kontekst 16384. Razlike med odjemalci so pri T007 in T008 in so pri štirih poskusih lahko naključne.
description.en: The same GPT-OSS 20B MXFP4 (llama.cpp b12141, Vulkan, context 4096) through different clients, one short round. Five cases (T001, T002, T007, T008, T009), user message only and default sampling (temperature 0.8): llama-cli 3/5, HTML chat 4/5, direct HTTP 4/5 and 4/5. Codex Local solved the agent task (fix stats.py, independent check) 2/2. OpenCode Local did not run: it needs a 16384 context. The differences between clients are in T007 and T008 and may be chance over four attempts.
